summary: Login/MFA change: when a user switches organization (POST select-organization), MFA is no longer re-prompted if they move between a root org and its sub-orgs (or between sibling sub-orgs); comparison now uses the session's root org id instead of its current org id. Switching to a different root org still requires MFA.

statements.why: Intended relaxation; MFA requirement is taken from the root org's policy anyway (auth-login-service.ts getRequiredMfaMethod(rootOrg, user)), and a different root org still triggers MFA. No hole found, though the card is silent on an MFA change.

statements.text: The agent changed backend/src/server/routes/v3/login-router.ts and backend/src/services/auth/auth-login-service.ts in ways plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what they do differently.
statements.why: True but hides that this is a login/MFA behaviour change, squarely in the area plain says it reads.

misses.what: MFA behaviour change: users who already passed MFA are no longer asked again when switching between an organization and its sub-organizations; only switching to a different top-level organization prompts again.
